description: Main source file for Bluetooth direction finding connectionless receiver demo using Zephyr RTOS, handling periodic advertising synchronization, CTE reception, and device scanning.

methods.name: sync_create_timeout_get
methods.description: Calculates timeout in milliseconds for creating periodic advertising sync based on interval.

methods.name: phy2str
methods.description: Converts PHY value to human-readable string.

methods.name: sample_type2str
methods.description: Converts IQ sample type to string.

methods.name: pocket_status2str
methods.description: Converts CTE CRC status to string.

methods.name: data_cb
methods.description: Callback to parse device name from advertisement data.

methods.name: sync_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when periodic advertising sync is established.

methods.name: term_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when periodic advertising sync is terminated.

methods.name: recv_cb
methods.description: Callback invoked when data is received in sync.

methods.name: cte_recv_cb
methods.description: Callback for CTE IQ sample reports.

methods.name: scan_recv
methods.description: Callback invoked upon device scan reception.

methods.name: create_sync
methods.description: Initiates creation of periodic advertising sync.

methods.name: delete_sync
methods.description: Deletes the established periodic advertising sync.

methods.name: scan_init
methods.description: Initializes scan and sync callback registration.
